notes.title: "USE YOUR WORDS 2" IS FINALLY HERE!
notes.content:
[b]OUR SEQUEL IS HERE![/b] After nearly 7 years since we launched [i]Use Your Words[/i], we're finally releasing a sequel, [i]Use Your Words [b]2[/b][/i]! Grab it right now by clicking [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3188960/Use_Your_Words_2/]HERE[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27296107/0e62c2c8a008f59b5b3962d324938de426e6a937.png[/img]

Want more info? Read below!

[b]LET'S TALK ABOUT NEW FEATURES:[/b]

- CUSTOMIZE WITH “MIX N’ MATCH MODE”

Create your own custom playlist of mini-games in whatever order you choose! Want to binge your favorite mini-game 6 times in a row? Go for it!

- SPECTATOR MODE IS MORE FUN!

Spectator mode has grown into an interactive meta-game that includes changing the main players’ scores, trivia questions, and even teasing players while they play!

- MORE RESPONSIVE

[i]Use Your Words 2 [/i]pays attention to how you’re playing and laughs along with you… it can give you tips based on your party’s behavior and also congratulate (or dunk on) your players as they play!

4 NEW MINI-GAMES

• Book It!: We show you a weird blank book cover and you write the title (fans of Paperback Paradise should enjoy this one!)

• Out of the Question: What if Jeopardy was funny? In our new lightning round, answer preposterous fake trivia questions with even more preposterous answers!

• Letterheads: Come up with ridiculous product names for vintage magazine ads by filling out three predetermined product initials.

• Sign Me Up!: Vandalize various signs and surfaces with your own labels, scrawls, and smart*ssery!

• And our 4 classic mini-games are back with a full load of all-new prompts!

So what are you waiting for? Grab [i]Use Your Words 2 [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3188960/Use_Your_Words_2/]HERE[/url] today!

Want even more information? Check out our...

[b]COMPLETE LIST OF FEATURES[/b]

• 8 hilarious mini-games that you can mix and match however you want!

• Over 600 prompts! (that’s up to 20 hours of non-repeating content!)

• Improved “Spectator Mode”

• Thousands of built-in house answers so you’ll never play the same game twice!

• Optimized for Streamers with optional “Streamer Mode” features

• Optional "Family Mode" filter so you can feel safe playing with any group.

• Make your own custom password to let in friends and keep out jerks!

• Support for all HTML5-enabled devices!

• Beautiful retro hand-drawn art by artist Andrew Kolb

• An authentic vintage “swingin’ 60s” soundtrack.

• Up to 1000 spectators can watch and affect the game in a variety of ways

Note: This game is played locally, but remote players can play via stream or video conference.
All included content is in English only. Some trailer footage may represent earlier phases of development. Default game contains mature content similar to[i] Use Your Words 2[/i] but such content can be filtered out using "Family Mode".

There you have it! Grab [i]Use Your Words 2 [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3188960/Use_Your_Words_2/]HERE[/url] today!

notes.title: Small Update - Silver Jester Achievement Fix
notes.content:
Hello all,

It was recently brought to our attention that the Silver Jester achievement was not triggering on Steam. This has been addressed and should now trigger when the criteria of 45k points in a single match is reached.

We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused, especially to those trying to get a full-set.

We are also looking into the various reports of crashes that have been posted on the community forums. Once we can narrow them down we will be posting an updated build with those fixes.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.

-Brent & Julian

tags.bug: This has been addressed and should now trigger when the criteria of 45k points in a single match is reached.

notes.title: Use Your Words v1.1 FREE CONTENT UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello again, Wordsmiths!

We know we've been pretty quiet around here, but we’re very excited to release this update! Here’s what’s new:

[h1]New Content[/h1]
We’ve added [b]100[/b] new prompts across all four mini-games for no additional charge! So if you’re one of the enthusiastic players who’ve seen every prompt in the game, you’ll be happy to know that about 25% of the material in this version is brand new!

[h1]French Localization[/h1]
Fun fact: France was once our top-selling region worldwide, and now rests solidly at the #2 spot. So we decided to say a big «Merci!» with 100 new prompts that French speakers can play in their native language! [i](Voiceover, prompt text, and instructions are in French, but certain UI / interface elements remain in English)[/i].

[h1]Updated Topical Content[/h1]
We began writing for Use Your Words all the way back in 2015, so some of our old topical material had become a bit stale. Version 1.1 has a newly curated complement of house answers and prompts so even the most dedicated players can be surprised all over again!

[h1]Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h1]
We’ve also continued to refine the game by addressing minor bugs.

And one more thing: While this update is the current official version on Steam, we’re open to the possibility that there may be room for improvement, especially with our French content. If you find anything that doesn’t quite feel right, we would love to hear your thoughts! 

You can submit feedback to support@smilingbuddhagames.com or reach out to us on Twitter [url=https://www.twitter.com/useyourwords]@useyouwords[/url].

notes.title: Use Your Words 1.02 Patch
notes.content:
Hi Wordsmiths!

We've pushed a new patch and this one comes with a whole bunch of fixes and adjustments based on the feedback you've given us. So, here's what's changed:

[h1]New Content[/h1]
First and foremost, we want to let you know that there are over [b]50 new prompts[/b] added in this patch including new Extra, Extras and Sub the Titles.

[h1]Pacing[/h1]
We realized the scoring sequences were long, especially during Sub the Title, so we have made a few format changes to really speed things up. Notably, you no longer have to watch the entire clip during the results phase. 

Also, tutorials can be skipped by pressing "Enter" (or "A" on a controller) during Sub The Title and Survey Says.

We've also trimmed some of the longer VO that kept you from getting into the game faster.

[h1]House Answers[/h1]
We know that some of you love the House Answers and we also know that some of you really don't. So, to that end we've added an option to the Settings menu to disable House Answers in your game. 

Players can still use House Decoys, but they'll definitely be easier to spot.

[h1]Bugfixes & Touchups[/h1]
We've also gone in and addressed a bunch of minor bugs and touched up some small things.

Thank you again for all of your support and we hope you enjoy the new update!

Best,
The Smiling Buddha Team

notes.title: Pacing Improvements, Bugfixes and More Prompts!
notes.content:
Hey there Wordsmiths!

We've been listening to the feedback that you guys have been giving us on social media and here on Steam, and we're working on an update that addresses some of those notes:

[h1]Pacing[/h1]
We know that some aspects of the game can really drag in 6-player games, especially during Sub the Title. We're working on pacing improvements across the board, including the ability to skip tutorials and a modified Sub the Title flow that speeds things up dramatically. 

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
We're continuing to fix bugs as we find them, including some of the issues that some of you with NVIDIA mobile GPUs have encountered.

[h1]More Prompts[/h1]
Finally, we'll be adding a bunch of new content across all of the games! We don't have a definite number yet, but we'll update when the patch is out.

[h1]Timeline[/h1]
We're targeting the end of May with this update, so stay tuned.

Thanks for all of your support and feedback! 

-Brent & Julian

notes.title: Use Your Words 1.01 Patch
notes.content:
Hi Steam users!

We've pushed a minor patch that addresses some stability issues, notably instances where the game gets into a situation where it can no longer progress.

We have also enabled the ability to resize the game's window when not in fullscreen mode.

If you encounter any issues with the game please post in the discussion page or message us at support@smilingbuddhagames.com.

-Julian
